# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `mixpanel` MCP server pointing at Mixpanel's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.mixpanel.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Mixpanel user login, with no API key, Node, or `npx` required.
- Logo: Mixpanel's official mark, from the `mixpanel` GitHub organization.
